name: survey-response
description: Business Evaluation phases 8 and 9 (prds/business-evaluation-plan.md § 5 'Added 11-16-26', rulings BE29 to BE33; decision 1 approved by Doug 11-20-26): one CSurveyResponse per submitted feedback survey, linked to what it is about (the engagement and its mentor at the time, the event, or the released Business Evaluation) and to the contact who answered. Multiple Assigned Users and Collaborators on: a response about an engagement carries the engagement's assignedUsers, which is how its mentor reads it. Additive only. No field Read-only: the application writes them all (ruling 40). Handoff: survey-response-crm-handoff.md. Role grants: scripts/migrate_feedback_roles.py.

fields.name: surveyKey
fields.label: Survey
fields.tooltipText: Which feedback survey was answered, such as mentoring-feedback.

fields.name: surveyVersion
fields.label: Survey version
fields.tooltipText: The survey definition answered, such as mentoring-feedback.v1.

fields.name: recommendScore
fields.label: Recommendation score
fields.tooltipText: How likely the person is to recommend us, 0 to 10. 6 or below is a low score.

fields.name: answers
fields.label: Answers (data)
fields.tooltipText: The submitted answers as JSON. People read Answers instead.

fields.name: needsFollowUp
fields.label: Needs follow-up
fields.tooltipText: Set by the application for a low score, or when the person asked to be contacted or to talk with a mentor.
